name: api_project_incidents_list
_description: GET /api/v1/project-incidents - lista imprevistos de obra. Filtros: status, project_id, include_closed (default false). Ordena detected_at DESC. JOIN projects para name. CTE inline (gotcha B64). webhookId UUID manual. alwaysOutputData en Postgres.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: { code: $json._error, message: $json._details || $json._error, request_id: 'req_' + Date.now() } }) }}

parameters.query: WITH ctx AS (SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok) SELECT i.id, i.tenant_id, i.project_id, i.detected_at, i.description, i.location, i.severity, i.causa_probable, i.options, i.selected_option_index, i.cost_delta_eur, i.time_delta_days, i.client_communication_draft, i.client_communication_sent_at, i.modification_doc_url, i.status, i.photos, i.created_at, p.name AS project_name FROM project_incidents i LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ctx) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR i.status = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR i.project_id = $5) AND ($6::boolean OR i.status != 'closed') ORDER BY i.detected_at DESC LIMIT $7::int

parameters.jsCode:
const items = $input.all().map(i => i.json).filter(j => j && j.id);
const sess  = $('Decode JWT + Params').first().json;

return [{ json: {
  data: items.map(i => ({
    id:                            i.id,
    tenant_id:                     i.tenant_id,
    project_id:                    i.project_id,
    project_name:                  i.project_name,
    detected_at:                   i.detected_at,
    description:                   i.description,
    location:                      i.location,
    severity:                      i.severity,
    causa_probable:                i.causa_probable,
    options:                       i.options,
    selected_option_index:         i.selected_option_index,
    cost_delta_eur:                i.cost_delta_eur != null ? parseFloat(i.cost_delta_eur) : null,
    time_delta_days:               i.time_delta_days,
    client_communication_draft:    i.client_communication_draft,
    client_communication_sent_at:  i.client_communication_sent_at,
    modification_doc_url:          i.modification_doc_url,
    status:                        i.status,
    photos:                        i.photos,
    created_at:                    i.created_at
  })),
  meta: {
    request_id: sess.request_id,
    timestamp:  new Date().toISOString(),
    count:      items.length,
    filters:    sess.filters
  }
}}];
